@Kshitij45__ ✍️India detected 5 cases of HMPV on Monday itself. 
✍️Two of the five cases were detected in Karnataka by the ICMR through routine surveillance for multiple respiratory viral pathogens. 
✍️Two more cases were later detected in Chennai. 
✍️One case was detected in Ahmedabad. https://t.co/y8wrogd0FU
